en: Black-and-white postcard showing a dense religious street procession in Bruges. Crowds line both sides of a broad street while clergy, nuns, and women in long dresses walk in the center, accompanying a large statue of the Virgin Mary with a radiant halo. Old European buildings frame the background. Printed captions in French run below the image, including the title indicating it is the Procession of the Holy Blood in Bruges.
